verdict.rationale: Retell has a broad programmatic surface. Its official Node.js and Python SDKs claim full coverage of voice and chat endpoints. A CLI manages agents, phone numbers and knowledge bases, and an MCP server can create, update and publish agents. Voice cloning has an API reference, and webhooks push call events. However, nothing states that the API matches the UI, and several dashboard features (Conductor, analytics dashboards, AI QA) appear only as UI or assistant workflows. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage for Conductor, analytics dashboards and AI QA configuration, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
